officialBodies.scopeLimit: User allowed-item hierarchical-group membership affects sales voucher visibility. Full mixed-item, warehouse/customer intersections and purchase/request applicability are not specified.

originalStaticFindings: Customer picker passes from-business context and can add account-specific customer conditions; a missing result is not proof a master record is absent.
Basic-code setup retrieves menu/model definitions and tenant/user context from an action response.
Simple-code list forwards business/parent/target/menu, include_codes, modified search-condition model, sort and pagination to server; actual ACL evaluation is outside these fragments.
The customer route authority_type Anonymous descriptor is not an observed unauthenticated or unrestricted server response.

ownCurrentBehavior.masterList: renderMasters has explicit stopped-code inclusion. The common options helper excludes disabled codes by default.
ownCurrentBehavior.searchPicker: ReferencePickerUI has explicit inactiveChoices toggle, staged selection and cancel; old selections are retained. Existing coverage inspected, not rerun.
ownCurrentBehavior.stockHelper: EntryCore.stockCandidates and stock import support includeZero; this is an input helper, not proof of full Simple Inventory Adjustment screen parity.
ownCurrentBehavior.allowedItemGroupAcl: No user-specific allowed-item hierarchical-group evaluation in inspected own master/picker/purchasing list paths. Existing whole-module account/company/role checks are separate.

zeroStockRelatedScope.reason: Separate inventory-adjustment scenario, not proof of a purchase master lookup defect; own stock helper already has zero inclusion and was not reimplemented or retested as a new feature.

remaining: Exact full manual017 and actual readonly purchase/request lookup and allowed-permission editor; registered but unseen may have distinct conditions.

Permission precedence for item/customer/warehouse groups, unassigned users, master/settings admins, nested groups, stopped/deleted codes and mixed-item vouchers; do not infer whole-voucher versus row filtering.
Server-enforced selection, detail, search, reports, exports and saved conditions must agree; popup route authority_type descriptor alone does not establish anonymous API access.
Existing account/company/menu role authorization is separate. No currently configured item-group ACL is being bypassed; the original feature is unsupported in the own app.
Synthetic permitted/denied identities and preservation, then hosted readonly acceptance. Original permission expansion, settings save, adjustment and business writes remain prohibited.
